name: item module start
reason: start-up: Item module start: reads the game window rectangle into the stored view rectangle, loads the four ammunition and seven armour coverage names from the item message file and sets the editor flag, wield replay flag and decay switch; our item window loads its names itself.

name: item module shutdown
reason: start-up: Item module shutdown: frees the ammunition name table, the coverage name table and the message file handle.

name: item module resize
reason: start-up: Window resize handler of the item module: stores the new window rectangle in the view rectangle globals that the restock on-screen test reads.

name: new character kit
reason: the kit as basic prototype numbers in creation order (background items, clothes or jacket, lockpicks, bandages); the inventory destroy, the background money (given by the caller), the item creation (a missing prototype is skipped by the caller) and the wear check of the clothes (the caller asks GameSessionOwner.CheckHeroWear) are the caller's; the armour-slot test is not modelled (a new character wears nothing before the start); the identified mark on the background's items is not modelled (the items keep their prototypes' flags)

name: item holder getter
reason: accessor: Takes an item and returns its holder handle when the item has its held flag; logs a diagnostic and fails for a loose item or a non-item type; our typed inventory records know their holder.

name: item type test
reason: accessor: Answers whether a handle is an item (object type from weapon 5 to generic 14); the null handle is not.

name: item inventory location getter
reason: accessor: Returns the inventory location field of an item (worn slots 1000..1008, hotkey slots 2000..2009, else a grid place) after the holder lookup; our records keep the location.

name: item effective power
reason: a critter owner only (the non-critter holder, whose power is the complexity, is ChargeCellRules.Need's, ARC-TECHNOLOGY-007)

name: item complexity getter
reason: accessor: Returns the magick or technology complexity field of an item.

name: item power percent
reason: Percent of the effective power over the complexity (100 when the complexity is 0); the rule is reproduced, the owner-type case (an owner that is not a critter) is in the session ratio host (SessionFlagReads.PowerRatio). The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Simulation.Equipment.EquipmentRules.EffectivePowerRatio, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: magick cancel chance
reason: only the chance; the both-critters test and the roll are the attack resolver's

name: technology failure chance
reason: only the chance; the PC or NPC wielder test, the throwing exclusion and the roll are the attack resolver's

name: item transfer
reason: the ground pickup path (via 0x461810); loot from a dead NPC uses the same transfer; gold and key rings are refused, a key item folds into the hero's key list (ARC-WORLD-123), ammunition merges into a held stack (ARC-WORLD-066); with the host's SCR dispatcher the item's get script runs before the insert check and can decline (ARC-SCRIPT-041) and the insert-item script runs after it (ARC-SCRIPT-013); a script that uses more than the item set admits refuses the transfer; the insert check is the host's; ARC-WORLD-071 (NT2, NT3): a hero item into an NPC's list (GiveItemToNpc: a worn item leaves its slot, ammunition merges, a given kit or taken item remembers its list) and an NPC's item to the hero (TakeItemFromNpc, the loot rules, with the item events of ARC-SCRIPT-041); GiveItemToNpc runs no script (an NPC transfer script refuses), the no-drop flag and NPC flag 0x40 are not modelled

name: item pickup transfer
reason: Ground item transfer into a holder: get script, insert check, removal from the tile, insertion and decay cancel; our pickup is the same for the hero and loot, with its known limits (no network, no other holders). The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Session.GameSessionOwner.PickUpItem, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: item drop on the owner's tile
reason: the hero only, from the inventory window's drop icon (ARC-UI-025): the drop script, the no-drop flag, the removal's events and the placement (junk pile, decay) through the session; a refusal after the drop script drops its writes (session policy); the network request and the drop script's own effects on the drop are the host's

name: item drop distance
reason: only the distance draw 2..4 the drop makes first; the drop's refusals, removal and placement are the session's (GameSessionOwner critical drops)

name: item drop
reason: Drop of an item by its owner: drop script, no-drop remove check, tile and placement; our drop is the hero only, and the NPC look-for bits it sets are not written. Read once (F1) and not compared branch by branch.

name: item transfer from a holder
reason: loot from a dead NPC or (ARC-WORLD-101) a container and negative IN: with the host's SCR dispatcher the recipient's transfer script (the holder as triggerer, the item as extra object) runs first and can decline, then the insert check, the removal's remove-item script and the insert-item script (ARC-SCRIPT-041); the no-drop check, worn items, gold and keys are refused or not modelled; containers as recipients are not modelled

name: item worthless check
reason: Answers whether the item worth field is 0; the AI ground item search skips such items; the search rule reads a Worthless flag that no host sets from the worth.

name: item price
reason: the barter quotes with the checks on; the unchecked branch of the repair quote (flag 1) is implemented only in its damage step (ItemDurabilityRules.ScalePrice), and a PC-to-PC or NPC-to-NPC price is not used

name: thrown range
reason: the item's weight is the caller's (the session keeps no item weights; the viewer passes the stored weight without its magic adjustment, 0x461370 not read)

name: thrown item damage
reason: the item's effective weight is the caller's (the weight function with its magic adjustment is not implemented)

name: item stack field map
reason: accessor: Returns which critter field names the stack of an item type (gold 0xE8 with quantity 0xA5, ammunition by type) and the quantity field; our typed gold and ammunition stacks replace the field numbers.

name: holder item by name
reason: Finds the first item whose name field equals a value in the inventory list of a container or critter (any other object holds nothing); our port answers yes or no for the dialog conditions in and ni, not the handle. Read once (F1) and not compared branch by branch.

name: holder item by prototype
reason: Searches a holder list for an item of a prototype under flags (skip worn items, match description, quick slot fallback); only the schematic assembly flag set 7 is reproduced. Read once (F1) and not compared branch by branch.

name: first item of type in pile
reason: Returns the first item of a given item type in a container list (or null); used by the AI junk pile search, whose world interface method FirstInPile has no host.

name: generic item with flag search
reason: Returns the first generic item (type 14) of a critter list whose generic flag matches the asked bit; reproduced for the healing flag only (not the lockpick, grenade or substitute container cases). The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.World.AreaAiHost.HealingItem, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: first inventory item
reason: Returns the first item of a critter or container list or null; used by the AI ground search; no host implements it.

name: inventory list snapshot
reason: Copies the whole list of a container or critter (worn items included) into a new handle array and returns its length for the Take all button; our Take all walks the loot view in list order. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.TerrainViewer.TerrainViewerApp.TakeAllFromBody, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: free handle array
reason: runtime library: Frees a handle array when it is not null (the end of the Take all button).

name: stack of the same prototype
reason: the hero's first held ammunition stack of the prototype; the prototype 15085 exclusion (not an ammunition prototype, so it never meets an ammunition merge) and a container's or an NPC's list are the session's callers'

name: item on hotkey bar check
reason: Finds another item of the same prototype of a holder that lies in a hotkey location (2000..2009), ignoring a special description; the bar drop refuses such an item; reproduced as the refusal in AssignHotkey. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Session.GameSessionOwner.AssignHotkey, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: hotkey item count

name: inventory use check

name: critter text line parser
reason: interpreted: Reads the next record of a critter rules text file, parsing its Key: value lines (flags, basic stats, spells, script, damage, hit points) and returns the prototype number or -1 at the end. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: hit point target setter
reason: interpreted: Sets an object's maximum hit points to a target by changing its hit point adjustment by the difference; used by the critter text parser for the Hit Points key. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: critter text key handler
reason: interpreted: Converts the value text of critter lines into field writes (flag names through 0x49BF10, stat and spell numbers, damage pair, script counters, hit points); called by the line parser 0x49B5A0. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: flag name lookup
reason: interpreted: Finds a name by case-insensitive prefix in a table of flag names and returns its flag bit, or reports an unknown flag and returns 0; the census range also holds a developer export of all critters to text. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: critter record text writer
reason: debug: Writes one critter prototype as a text record (stats, flags, spells, damage, script, hit points) in the critter rules file format; used only by the developer export of the critters to text files.

name: flag names writer
reason: debug: Writes a line with the table name of every bit set in a flag mask; helper of the developer critter text export.

name: multiplayer module init
reason: Module init: checks or creates the Players folder, sets the default player name and 8 player maximum, clears the 8 slots and the character caches and loads the multiplayer message file; returns 1. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: multiplayer module exit
reason: Module exit: stops the network if running, frees a pending list and the per-slot character blobs, destroys the pending-request table, unloads the message file and the matchmaker layer. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: multiplayer module reset
reason: Module reset (skipped while a reset-suppress counter is set): stops the network, recreates the pending table, restores the default module and player names and 8 players, clears the slots and tables and removes the multiplayer timer event. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: multiplayer module save
reason: Writes the multiplayer module's part of a save: markers, the ids of stored characters of players who left and the slot table. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: multiplayer module load
reason: Reads the multiplayer module's part of a save back: markers, stored character ids and the slot table. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: module data load stub
reason: other: Module data-load slot of the multiplayer module: does nothing and returns 1.

name: multiplayer module unload
reason: Module unload: raises the remote-change counter, destroys the loaded character objects through 0x4A3D00 and lowers the counter again. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: clear player slot
reason: Clears one 80-byte player-table slot: zeroes its record, marks no party (-1) and sets default flags. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network start
reason: Starts the network layer (0x5271D0), registers the packet dispatcher 0x49D690, the validator 0x4A2020 and the event handler 0x4A2070 and clears the remote-change counter; returns 1 on success. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network stop
reason: Unregisters the dispatcher and stops the network layer, clearing the network-active word and the counter; returns 1 when the layer reports stopped. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: become host forwarder
reason: thunk: Jumps to the network host start 0x527E80; the census range also holds an unreferenced next function that stores a callback in a global read by 0x4A2A30.

name: start module instance
reason: Host start of a game: checks the module's .dat, makes a new world instance with a fresh GUID, loads the module and the temporary save and sets game running (tail 0x49CEE0). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: create player character
reason: Creates and starts a joining slot's player character: object creation, the reset 0x4A6010, the auto-equip 0x4A5670, placement and notification of the others. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: multiplayer timer event
reason: Time event of the multiplayer game: periodic broadcasts to clients, sends of the time and removal of players who left, offering a leaving player to save their character. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: timer event match test
reason: Predicate over a time-event entry that is true for an integer-parameter entry whose value equals a global; passed as a filter by the multiplayer timer event. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: open multiplayer map
reason: Opens a map by name for a multiplayer game: validates the object system before and after the load and loads the map files from the current save folder. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network packet dispatcher
reason: One switch on the packet type 1..130 (six types empty) that applies a received packet: client requests on the host only, host replication on clients only; reached only as a registered callback. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: apply animation goal
reason: Applies a received animation goal to an object: when the object handle is set forwards the six values to 0x43E770; called by the dispatcher for the animation packets. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: slot to object
reason: Slot number 0..7 to the player object: looks up the slot's stored ID in the object registry and stores the handle; returns 1 when found, else a null handle and 0. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: broadcast player list
reason: When the network is a host builds the list of the admitted slots' object IDs and sends it to all clients (packet type 2). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: packet type validator
reason: Validator registered with the network layer: accepts packet types 1..130; type 0 and anything outside the range is refused. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: notice broadcast
reason: Sends a notice packet (type 67) with one value to all clients. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network event handler
reason: Handler for network events 0..13: 5 a join request (admission, level and password checks), 8 a client left, 11 the game started; runs the notification hook 0x4A2A30. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network notice hook
reason: callback slot: Calls the function in the global stored by the unreferenced setter after 0x49CC50 when set, else tail-calls 0x4606E0 (a second hook slot); called by the network event handler.

name: player lagging notice
reason: For a given object: marks it lagging locally (0x433170) and on the host broadcasts packet 0x44. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: player recovered notice
reason: For a given object: marks it recovered locally (0x433220) and on the host broadcasts packet 0x45. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: clear slot by number
reason: Clears the player-table slot of a given number through 0x49CB80. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network flag setter
reason: accessor: Stores its argument in a global read in the packet dispatcher region; called by two interface functions.

name: object to slot
reason: Object to slot number: for each of the 8 slots checks it is active and its player object equals the given handle; returns 0..7 or -1. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: slot to player object
reason: Returns the player object handle of an active slot, or null. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network apply test
reason: Network test: answers 1 in single player and in a network game only while the dispatcher applies a received packet; callers apply locally on 1, else broadcast. Single player always takes the local branch. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: remote change count up
reason: Raises the counter that marks a received change being applied. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: remote change count down
reason: Lowers the remote-change counter, not below zero. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: first player object
reason: Starts a walk over the players: in single player returns the hero (0x40DA50); in a network game the first active slot's player object (null when none). The single-player branch is the hero lookup our session provides. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: next player object
reason: Continues the player walk of 0x4A2BE0 with the next active slot's object, null at the end; callers include the AI near and tick-distance tests. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: queue animation record
reason: Allocates a 0x1B0-byte record, copies a received animation record into it and pushes it on a pending list; called by the dispatcher. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: animation goal sync
reason: Network handling of an animation goal: on the host (network bit 2) sends the goal data to the clients, on a client applies it through 0x4A1F30; read at call level only. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: free lock list
reason: Frees every record of the object-lock list; called by the module init. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: host lock check
reason: Host side of an item lock request: checks the object's lock flag and calls the granted or denied callback (0x4A3080/0x4A3030 keep the lock records). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: add lock record
reason: Pushes a new lock record (object ID, second ID, holder value, count 1) onto the lock list. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: find lock record
reason: Finds the lock record of an object ID in the lock list, null when none. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: release object lock
reason: Lowers the lock count of an object that carries the lock flag; at zero clears the flag and removes the record. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: remove lock record
reason: Removes the lock record of an object ID from the lock list and frees it. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: item lock request
reason: Lock request that item insert, remove and placement call: single player runs the granted callback at once; the host checks the lock; a client stores the callback under a sequence number marks the item busy and sends packet 80. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: send map files
reason: Host side of a join: sends the current map's files and a transfer file with the animation, magic-tech and trap module states to the client, with post-handlers 0x4A54A0 and 0x4A54E0. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: send players folder
reason: Sends the Players folder (character files) to a joining client through a temporary folder. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: send other characters
reason: Sends the other players' character files and portraits to a joining client. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: empty function
reason: other: Does nothing and returns at once.

name: clock global getter
reason: accessor: Returns a global word; its only caller is the clock step 0x45B370.

name: save player character
reason: Host: writes the local player's character file (0x4A39F0) and calls the given completion callback; client: asks the host with packet 46 and schedules a timeout event. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: save callback setter
reason: accessor: Stores a completion callback and its argument in two globals; called by the save of 0x4A38B0.

name: write character file
reason: Writes a PC to Players\G_<GUID>.mpc: serialises the object with its auto-level scheme after the inventory is dropped, plus two portrait bitmaps. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: destroy character list
reason: Destroys every object of the loaded character-file list and frees the list. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: list character files
reason: Lists the Players\G_*.mpc files, loads each with 0x4A3F40 into the list and counts them. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: import character file
reason: Reads a character file into a new object; refuses a PC that carries an inventory or followers. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: slot character present
reason: accessor: Tells whether a slot has a received character blob.

name: store slot character
reason: Stores a received character blob (ID, size and bytes) in a slot, freeing the old one. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: slot character data
reason: accessor: Returns a pointer to the bytes of a slot's character blob, or null.

name: slot character size
reason: accessor: Returns the byte size of a slot's character blob, or 0.

name: slot character id
reason: accessor: Copies the object ID stored with a slot's character blob, or a null ID.

name: slot character record
reason: accessor: Returns the raw record pointer of a slot's character blob.

name: slot character object bytes
reason: accessor: Returns a pointer 0x28 bytes into the slot's character blob, or null.

name: reset suppress count up
reason: accessor: Raises a counter that makes the multiplayer module reset do nothing; called by two windows.

name: reset suppress count down
reason: Lowers the reset-suppress counter; the census range also holds the separate next function 0x4A4290 (no callers) that builds a character file path from an object and stores one file-layer result, role not settled. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: save local hero character
reason: Builds Players\<id>.mpc for the local hero, applies one field change (0x424070) and writes the character with 0x4A39F0; returns success. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: cache character info
reason: Adds or updates a character-file info entry (ID, name and description text) in a ring of 8 entries. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: find cached character
reason: Finds an object ID among the 8 cached character-file info entries and copies out its strings; returns -1 when absent. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: write scheme to file
reason: Writes character-file data (the auto-level scheme included) of a PC into its Players file and refreshes the info cache; called by the character windows and the auto-level run. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: read character header
reason: Reads a character file's header strings from the Players folder or the temporary copy into the info cache. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: read character extra
reason: Reads a character file's header and extra data strings into the info cache; same shape as 0x4A47D0 with one more read. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: character portrait path
reason: Builds the portrait bitmap path Players\<id><suffix>.bmp of a multiplayer PC (used by the portrait draw, PO3). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: matchmaker config read
reason: Reads Rules\Matchmaker.mes and copies several entries into globals of the matchmaker layer. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: item pick flag set
reason: Single player: sets the no-display item flag (0x10) on the picked item and returns 1; a network player also reserves the pick in a per-slot table and broadcasts packet 93. Steamwoven writes no such flag.

name: item pick flag clear
reason: Clears the pick flag set by 0x4A50D0 on an item when the item is put down or moved in the same holder; for the local player in a network game also releases the slot reservation and sends a packet.

name: clear pick table
reason: Zeroes the table of 8 per-slot reserved item handles; called by module init and reset. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: reserve slot item
reason: Reserves an item for a slot if the slot holds none yet and sets the item's no-display flag; returns 1 on success. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: release slot item
reason: Clears the reservation of an item for a slot and the item's no-display flag. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: clear open window table
reason: Zeroes the table of 8 per-slot container handles; called by module init and reset. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: set open container
reason: Stores the container a slot has open in the per-slot table and, for a local change in a network game, broadcasts packet 97; the inventory window close also reaches it. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: container open check
reason: Tells whether an object handle is in the per-slot open-container table; called by the junk pile dissolve in a network game.

name: matchmaker ping
reason: Module ping slot: when the matchmaker layer is loaded (0x4A4ED0) calls its poll 0x4A4EE0. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: restart animations after transfer
reason: Post-handler of a transferred animation module state: for each live record of the animation table that has not ended restarts it. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: restart spell runs after transfer
reason: Post-handler of the transferred magic-tech state: restarts each active spell run of the 0x158-byte table. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: set slot option bits
reason: Sets bits of mask 0xFF00 in a slot's flag word and broadcasts the result (packet 98). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: clear slot option bits
reason: Clears bits of mask 0xFF00 in a slot's flag word and broadcasts the result (packet 98). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: slot option bits
reason: accessor: Returns a slot's flag word masked with 0xFF00 (the player option bits).

name: stored character limit
reason: accessor: Returns the maximum of stored characters of players who left (default 10).

name: set stored character limit
reason: accessor: Stores the maximum of stored characters of players who left.

name: apply player settings
reason: Applies a player's stored options always run, auto attack, auto switch and follower skills through 0x430580, 0x4B8280, 0x4B8380 and 0x4C8FF0; called only from multiplayer code. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip joining character
reason: Entry of the multiplayer auto-equip: loads Rules\AutoEquip.mes and, when the server option allows it, gives the joining PC gold and items by background, skills and scheme, then wields the best. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip gold
reason: Creates starting gold from an AutoEquip entry scaled by the PC's background money and inserts it into the PC's inventory. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip background items
reason: Gets the background's item list and gives those items to the PC through 0x4A5E10. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip skill stage
reason: Auto-equip stage that picks AutoEquip entries from a stat and skill counts of the PC and gives them through 0x4A5920. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip entry give
reason: Looks up an AutoEquip entry and its follow-up entry and gives or wields the items through 0x4A5D80 and 0x4A5E10. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip stat stage
reason: Auto-equip stage that chooses entries from skill counts with cut-offs 75 and 20 and gives them through 0x4A5920. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip race stage
reason: Auto-equip stage that maps the PC's race class and two stats to an entry number and gives it through 0x4A5920. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip wield list
reason: Parses a list of prototype numbers from entry text and tries to wield each (0x462540), counting the successes. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip item list
reason: Parses a list of prototype numbers from entry text, creates each item with the creation wrapper 0x4ED8B0 and inserts it into the PC (0x4617F0). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip schematic items
reason: Auto-equip stage that gives the product of the highest learned technology schematic per discipline (schematic number 1990 + 200 per discipline + 10 per degree). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: player character export reset
reason: Resets a player character for a multiplayer export or join: hit point and fatigue damage, combat state, quests, rumors, blessings and curses, reputations, followers, flags, variables and spell flags are cleared; multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET).

name: multiplayer damage veto
reason: Answers whether damage from one critter to another is vetoed by the multiplayer player-killing and friendly-fire options, looking at the critter types, their leaders and a network option word; multiplayer is deferred. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: character export to file
reason: Exports a player character to a file after export and overwrite prompts: saves a temporary game, resets the character, writes the file and reloads the temporary save; multiplayer is deferred. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: character file name check
reason: Splits a character file path and tests the name part for a fixed trailing pattern when it is long, optionally rebuilding the path without it; part of the multiplayer character files, which are deferred. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: experience table load
reason: project admission: an entry that is not a number is refused instead of read with atoi

name: level scheme tables release
reason: start-up: At exit frees the message files and tables the level-up rules loaded (user and game level scheme files, name and cost tables); nothing to port.

name: level recalculation
reason: a PC without effects on its level; the scheme runs through the caller's per-level step (ARC-WORLD-036); each level written is reported for its level-up message, which the viewer posts (ARC-UI-046)

name: follower level update
reason: the follower's level and points; the session runs its scheme (GameSessionOwner.LevelFollower)

name: critter auto-level scheme read
reason: accessor: Returns the auto-level scheme number stored in a player character or NPC (minus one for any other object); our sheets carry the scheme as a plain field.

name: auto-level scheme setter
reason: the hero's scheme and the NPC advancement records; a number outside 0..199 is refused, where the original stores any number and buys nothing with it (a documented deviation: the snapshot bounds schemes to 0..199)

name: level scheme entry check
reason: Returns the scheme number when its rule text exists (numbers 1 to 49 in the user file and 50 to 199 in the game file) and 0 otherwise; ours answers the rule text or null and the caller tests it. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Data.Characters.AutoLevelTables.Rule, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: level set
reason: only the scheme run of a new PC; the reset to the default sheet, the experience and the points of a level above 1 are the starting hero's (a new PC is level 1)

name: auto-level scheme run
reason: the purchase text is built by the viewer from the run's purchases (ARC-UI-046, AreaLevelMessages); no multiplayer scheme

name: scheme rule run
reason: the rule is parsed once by Parse, which refuses a missing target, a target of more than 9 digits, a college target above 5 or a discipline target above 7 and text outside printable ASCII

name: level-up purchase log
reason: Logs one purchase of the level-up text by name: a repeated name only updates its value and at most ten names are kept; the text is built from the log afterwards. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.World.AreaLevelMessages.SchemeText, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: light hour table allocate
reason: start-up: Allocates the table of 24 hourly colour entries used by the ambient light scheme and answers 1.

name: light scheme default apply
reason: start-up: Applies the default light scheme at hour 12 through the scheme setter; only referenced as a start-up hook, no direct caller.

name: light scheme catalogue load
reason: Opens the lighting schemes catalogue at module load and applies the default scheme at hour 12; ours reads the catalogue and every scheme file in one strict read. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Data.Lighting.AreaLightingReader.Read, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: light scheme catalogue release
reason: start-up: Frees the opened lighting schemes catalogue and marks the current scheme as none at module unload.

name: light hour table release
reason: start-up: Frees the table of hourly colour entries at exit.

name: light scheme save
reason: Writes the current light scheme number and the hour it was set for to the save; our ambient light is recomputed from the clock and the active sector and is not saved.

name: light scheme load
reason: Reads the saved light scheme number and hour and applies them through the scheme setter; our ambient light is recomputed after a load instead.
